top_signals.title: Keel shutters all US bitcoin mining operations amid continuing AI pivot
top_signals.summary: Like many other Bitcoin miners, Keel has been shifting its focus from mining in favor of becoming a supplier of AI infrastructure.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.

top_signals.title: Hackers breached a small Polish energy plant via private APN last year
top_signals.summary: Hackers breached a heat-and-power plant facility in Poland, which supplies heat to about 50,000 residents, using a private APN (Access Point Name) to access an OT (Operational Technology) network. [...]
